user.title: Create an observe-only scheduler
user.description: Starts in observe-only mode: existing heating controls stay in charge. Add zones, review the proposed schedules and smart modes in the companion card. Heating commands require explicit control-mode activation after a reviewed handover. Review each zone before enabling heating control.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one scheduler instance is supported.

settings.title: Zone settings
settings.description: Keep the same thermostat and units; create a new zone to replace a device. Limits must accommodate schedules, holds and smart-mode targets. Manage boost ownership and timer changes in the companion card Settings. If control mode is enabled, these settings can affect heating after reload.

data.name: Zone name
data.baseline_temperature: Initial baseline (does not overwrite saved schedules)
data.manual_policy: Resume after an observed manual target change
data.manual_minutes: Hold duration in minutes (duration policy only)

schedule.title: Edit weekly schedule
schedule.description: Use the companion card for visual editing, or supply exactly mon through sun here. Each day contains ordered periods with start (HH:MM), temperature and optional label, beginning at 00:00. Ends follow the next start; the last extends to 24:00. Saving re-evaluates heating if control mode is enabled. Close without submitting to cancel.

resume.title: Clear manual hold?
resume.description: This clears only the scheduler's stored manual hold. It will not switch on heating or cancel an external boost. A physically off thermostat stays off.

advanced.title: Add a heating zone
advanced.description: Choose a single-target heating climate entity. Review limits and an initial baseline in its unit (Celsius or Fahrenheit). The baseline fills all seven days until edited. These are application bounds, not a protection guarantee. If heating control is already enabled for the scheduler, new enabled zones also participate. An optional existing boost timer establishes external ownership; configure its adapter in the card Settings.

data.name: Zone name
data.manual_policy: Resume after an observed manual target change
data.manual_minutes: Hold duration in minutes (duration policy only)

guided.title: 1 · Choose your thermostat
guided.description: Choose an available heating thermostat and a name. Nothing is created until the final review.

limits.title: 2 · Review temperatures
limits.description: These values use {unit}. The all-day target is a simple starting schedule for all seven days; edit periods visually in the card afterwards. Review the minimum carefully before using a low frost target.

options.title: 3 · Optional features
options.description: All targets use the thermostat unit. Optional person entity (person.name) keeps a minimum Mon–Fri 08:30–16:30 when home. Other presence sensors, times and external boost scripts can be configured in the card later. Preheating needs measured heating cycles. Frost is optional; heating while Off requires its separate switch.

data.frost_while_off: Allow temporary frost heating while Off

review.title: 4 · Review before creating
review.description:
{summary}

The new zone is created DISABLED, even when this scheduler already controls other zones. Review its schedule and settings in the card, then enable zone scheduling through Manage thermostat and limits when ready. Saving this form does not command the thermostat.

error.invalid_zone: Check the thermostat is available, supports heat with a single target, is not mapped twice, and has reviewed limits/targets matching its capabilities. Existing schedules and holds must also fit new limits. When replacing a device, create a new zone.
error.invalid_schedule: Supply a complete valid week with ordered unique starts, a 00:00 baseline for each day, and temperatures within this zone's limits/increment. If another editor saved first, close and reopen this editor to refresh its revision.
error.save_failed: Storage could not be saved. Nothing was committed; check storage and try again.

abort.schedule_saved: Schedule saved. Heating follows the selected control mode.
abort.preview_resumed: Stored manual hold cleared. A physically off thermostat stays off.
